title_en: Build Paginator that stops on an empty page
spec_html_en: Write class Paginator implementing the iterator protocol. __init__(self, fetch_page) stores a zero-argument callable fetch_page that returns a list of items for the next page, or an empty list when there is no more data. __iter__ returns self. __next__ calls fetch_page(): if it returns a non-empty list, return it; if it returns an empty list, raise StopIteration.
